title: How late can a reefer service be requested before the vessel departs?
content:
## Scope

This time rule of **Reefer Cargo Services** decides whether a reefer service request is on time or late, and what happens to a late request, for every tier.

## Rule

1. The clock is anchored on the scheduled departure date (ETD) held on the company's booking record for the booking of the request.
2. The request is **on time** when its date is no later than the booking's ETD date less the tier's lead days, counted on calendar dates. A request dated exactly on that latest on-time date is on time.
3. A request received later than that is **late**. A late request is accepted only when the tier accepts late requests, and then with the late request fee.
4. A late request on a tier that accepts one is charged the late request fee **once**.

## Tier table

| Tier | Lead days before ETD (calendar days) | Late request accepted | Late request fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 3 | Yes | 75.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 3 | Yes | 75.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 10 | No | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 7 | Yes | 150.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 7 | Yes | 150.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 14 | No | 0.00 USD |

## How to count (step by step)

1. Take the ETD date from the booking record.
2. Count back the tier's lead days on the calendar. The date reached is the latest on-time request date.
3. Compare the request date with it: on or before it is on time; after it is late.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical ETD of 20 May)

| Tier | Latest on-time date | Request dated | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 17 May | 17 May | On time; no late request fee |
| AHL Reefer Standard | 17 May | 18 May | Late; accepted with the 75.00 USD late request fee |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 13 May | 13 May | On time |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 13 May | 14 May | Late; accepted with the 150.00 USD late request fee |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 10 May | 11 May | Late; not accepted, because the tier does not accept late requests |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 6 May | 6 May | On time |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 6 May | 7 May | Late; not accepted |

## Truth table

| Request timing | Tier accepts late requests | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| On time | Either | This time rule does not stop the request and no late request fee arises |
| Late | Yes | Accepted, with the tier's late request fee charged once |
| Late | No | Not accepted |

## Basis Q&A

**The customer says the vessel has been delayed and so the request is really on time.** The count runs from the ETD date on the booking record, not from the customer's account of the sailing.

**Are lead days business days?** No. They are counted on calendar dates.
